The Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x (14" Snapdragon) laptop delivers next-gen efficiency in a slim, lightweight design, powered by the Snapdragon® X2 Elite processor. With low power consumption, all-day battery life, and a 14" OLED touchscreen display with optional 2.8K 120Hz PureSight Pro technology, you can create wherever you go.
Bright, Accurate Colors That Are Easy on the Eyes

Witness every detail perfectly with the optional OLED touchscreen display with HDR, 1100 nit peak brightness, and DisplayHDR True Black 1000 certification. Enjoy vibrant colors, lifelike accuracy, and enhanced highlights and shadow details. Create, edit, and watch HDR content with clarity.
Wide Color Gamut and Precise Color Accuracy

Score high color gamut with 100% sRGB, P3 and 99% Adobe RGB, along with Delta E<1 color accuracy. The screen delivers precise color reproduction for vivid visuals and cinema-quality content. It ensures your work stays true to your vision without compromise.

A 120Hz Variable Refresh Rate* delivers sharper frames and fluid transitions. Whether creating animations or watching movies, the smoother motion ensures precise detail, helping content creators achieve professional results with ease.
*Available on models with the 2.8K OLED display

Create longer and more comfortably with TÜV Low Blue Light, TÜV Eyesafe, and TÜV Flicker-Free certification. Minimize eye strain and fatigue, helping you stay focused during extended sessions, whether you’re creating or multitasking.
The Fastest, Most Intelligent Windows PCs Ever
Creativity isn’t just about getting things done – it’s about making space for everyone to create. Windows tools are built to empower everyone to easily shape ideas and bring bold visions to life.
Every Idea Deserves a Sounding Board

Big ideas, tricky tasks, new tools – whatever’s on your mind, Copilot is right there, ready to lend a hand. From the convenience of your desktop, it’s your thinking partner, your organizer, your guide – helping you move forward with ease.
Describe It. Find It, Like Magic
Skip the scavenger hunt – just type what you remember and improved Windows Search delivers. Docs, settings, or images? Use File Explorer, Windows Search, or Settings Search.*
*Works with specific text, image, and document formats only; optimized for select languages (English, Chinese (Simplified), French, German, Japanese, and Spanish).See aka.ms/copilotpluspcs
Make it make sense. Click to Do lets you act on text in an instant – just select and go.*
*Image actions now available across devices; other actions vary by device, region, language, and character set. Subscription required for some actions. See aka.ms/copilotpluspcs
The Most Secure Windows PCs Yet
Loaded with layers of hardware-based security such as Secured-core PC and the Microsoft Pluton security processor. It's like having your own digital bodyguard.

A creative partner built into your Yoga PC that thinks alongside you, sees what's on your screen, and works through your deepest ideas until the work comes out fully formed.

Installation of Lenovo Qira requires a PC running Windows 11 with a minimum of 16GB of memory. Lenovo Qira is gradually rolling out across eligible devices through preloads and future system updates. Availability may vary by model, market, and update timing.

The Yoga Ecosystem turns any space into a studio. With your PC, pen, supporting sleeve and accessories* working in sync, they support every step of your workflow, so your ideas can flow wherever you are.

Earbuds That Keep You Moving - The Lenovo TWS Yoga PC Edition earbuds are made for your workflow. With instant pairing, effortless device switching, and AI-enhanced call clarity, they keep you immersed from creative sessions to calls – while the all-day battery keeps you moving.
The Yoga Bluetooth Silent Mouse is made for uninterrupted flow. With noise-free clicks, ergonomic comfort, and award-winning design*, it’s the tool that moves as smoothly as the ideas it supports.
* Winner of the 2025 Red Dot Product Design Award, learn more here: https://www.red-dot.org/project/lenovo-yoga-bluetooth-silent-mouse-82635
The Stand That Supports Every Move

More than protection, the Lenovo Yoga Tote Sleeve is a creative partner. It carries your PC, Pen, and optional accessories together, then transforms into a sturdy stand for sketching and viewing — so creativity can happen wherever inspiration leads.
THE CHIP BUILT FOR AI BRILLIANCE
Level Up With Adobe Creative Cloud Pro

Jumpstart your creative journey with a 2-month Adobe Creative Cloud Pro membership. Access flagship software like Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro plus Adobe Firefly creative AI for images, video, and audio. Enhance your skills with tutorials and connect with a thriving creative community — explore limitless possibilities with Creative Cloud Pro. Terms & conditions apply.

** Not all Adobe apps may be supported on the ARM architecture of the Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x (14" Snapdragon) laptop. Please check www.helpx.adobe.com/download-install/apps/system-requirements/apps-compatibility-copilot.html for details on which apps are compatible.
